findings.text: _retire_the_landed_pointer is a one-line forwarder to pending_landing.retire_the_landed_pointer; the indirection adds a module hop for a capability the owner already exposes.

finish_a_promoted_head calls merge._rev_parse, merge._is_ancestor and merge._current_branch, all private to reckon/crew/merge.py; a rename there breaks this silently, since no test exercises the private-name contract directly.

justifications.durability: logs/negative-control.log shows tests/test_a_raced_promotion_still_lands.py::test_two_promotions_of_one_implementation_land_it_once failing in 2.18s when the landing step is no-op'd, so the assertion reddens on the regression rather than tracking a value the test itself supplied.
justifications.evidence: logs/baseline-arm.log (afca608a, 4 failed 10 passed) and logs/after-arm.log (2aac3ecc, 4 failed 11 passed) record the two arms, and logs/base-new-test.log shows the new test failing at base in 2.35s with the pending_landing_repair CrewError.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:243 follows the surrounding module's style and helper naming; reckon/crew/promotion.py:339 adds a forwarder beside the guard it decorates.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:2300 calls _finish_the_landing_the_row_owed on the already_promoted path, which is the raced-promotion state the goal names.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:272 delegates the merge to merge.land and the pointer retirement to runs.pointer_path/_pointer_lock, extending the owning modules rather than reimplementing them.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff afca608a..4d589adac is one of the four declared write paths; no unrelated file is touched.

verdicts.diff: VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against base afca608a; 2aac3ecc adds the landing helpers and the test, 4d589adac records the evidence fragment, 440 insertions across 4 files.
verdicts.done_when: VERDICT done_when: the done_when names a two-promotion case; tests/test_a_raced_promotion_still_lands.py:test_two_promotions_of_one_implementation_land_it_once asserts the second promotion lands the head and retires the pointer.
verdicts.goal: VERDICT goal: the goal is that a racing promotion lands the reviewed head its row names; reckon/crew/promotion.py:_finish_the_landing_the_row_owed does exactly that on the already_promoted path.
verdicts.manifest: VERDICT manifest: read; it states the after-arm log and the base-arm log and a negative control, and the logs on disk carry the same revisions and exit codes.
verdicts.write_paths: VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are promotion.py, pending_landing.py, the raced-promotion test and the evidence fragment; all four files in the diff are inside that scope.
